Hi there! I am a computer scientist with interests in distributed and decentralized computing, AI, and cryptography. I have worked in a wide area of domains, including distributed debugging, fault-tolerant and large-scale computing, data engineering, data science, and machine learning.

I enjoy studying stuff. I learn by writing and doing, and this is a place I work through questions in public.
